notes.title: Jammin' Rabbit Dev Update, New Project In the Works
notes.content:
It's been a little over a year since the release of American University Life ~Welcome Week!~ as well as my last announcement on what I would be working on in the future.

As a freelance writer I've been hopping around projects, my own and for other independent developers. This is irresponsible on my part since my last announcement talked about working on 74901 as well as making gradual progress on a fuller game of AUL.

The truth is I had been losing inspiration on both AUL and 74901. I didn't want to work on them half-heartedly and end up producing a lackluster visual novel. My search to find inspiration led me to other horizons.

In the past year, I was recruited by Tamaya Kagiya to work on an eroge genderbender visual novel titled I am Succubus as its main writer but that fell through. If anyone wants to follow up on that, you can check it out here .

What does this mean for AUL and 74901? I'm putting them off for now, and will return to them at a later date. I apologize to all the people who expressed interest in either games, as well as the artists who put so much work in such great designs. Though I am cutting back working on 74901, I plan to reveal the backgrounds and character design, including plot and backstory of those characters. This will be done in another post at a later date on my website.

During the time I worked on I am Succubus I did find inspiration, but not the kind that can be directed to 74901 and AUL. However, it is something that I have been working furiously on for the past few months, and have grown fond of as it comes to life.

This project draws a lot from Lovecraftian cosmic horror and will feature a host of alien god(desses). Without further adieu, this is These Cosmic Horrors Are Kind of Cute! 

Can you guess who some of these are supposed to represent from their appearance?

Character designs by Resuta.
